projectSummary: A second independent cadaveric series reporting three constant pectoral nerve branches rather than two, which is the same disagreement with tertiary descriptions recorded above.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

study.intervention: Cadaveric dissection of the pectoral nerves.
study.population: Twenty-six brachial plexuses from 15 fresh cadavers were dissected and the origins, locations, courses and branches of the pectoral nerves were recorded. Three constant branches were found.

title: The anatomy of the pectoral nerves and its significance in breast augmentation, axillary dissection and pectoral muscle flaps.
